description: Shared corpus of the state.yaml projectors (REQ-lifecycle-kernel-035). scripts/lib/ospec-state.test.js and internal/hooks/phase-completion-reducer_test.go project each input with the design envelope and require the same status from the state readers (readStatus and the pre-compact reader in Node, store.ReadStatus in Go), the same outcome and, when it is not malformed-state, the same bytes with the last_updated line replaced by `last_updated: <now>`; a malformed-state leaves the bytes unchanged. Both projectors trim a line, a key and a value only of the space, the tab and the CR: U+0085, U+FEFF, U+00A0 and every other Unicode space are text.
